papers.title: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation
papers.authors: John Schulman, Philipp Moritz, Sergey Levine, Michael Jordan, Pieter Abbeel
papers.summary: 用指数加权的 TD 残差估计优势，通过 λ 控制偏差与方差。
papers.summary_en: Estimate advantages from exponentially weighted TD residuals, with lambda controlling the bias–variance tradeoff.
papers.scope: 实现 GAE 的反向递推和 episode 边界处理。
papers.scope_en: Implement the backward GAE recurrence and episode boundary handling.

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.authors: John Schulman, Filip Wolski, Prafulla Dhariwal, Alec Radford, Oleg Klimov
papers.summary: 在策略目标中截断概率比，限制过大的策略更新带来的收益。
papers.summary_en: Clip probability ratios in the policy objective to limit the incentive for excessively large updates.
papers.scope: 实现 clipped surrogate 及其梯度行为；价值损失、归一化和统计代码已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the clipped surrogate and its gradient behavior; value loss, normalization, and diagnostics are supplied.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.authors: Rafael Rafailov, Archit Sharma, Eric Mitchell, Stefano Ermon, Christopher D. Manning, Chelsea Finn
papers.summary: 将偏好对上的隐式奖励差转化为直接优化语言模型的分类目标。
papers.summary_en: Turn the implicit reward margin of preference pairs into an objective that directly optimizes a language model.
papers.scope: 实现偏好损失与隐式奖励；token 对齐和序列 log-prob 计算已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the preference loss and implicit rewards; token alignment and sequence log-probability calculation are supplied.

papers.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
papers.authors: Zhihong Shao, Peiyi Wang, Qihao Zhu, Runxin Xu, Junxiao Song, Xiao Bi, Haowei Zhang, Mingchuan Zhang, Y. K. Li, Y. Wu, Daya Guo
papers.summary: 使用同一问题的一组回答构造相对优势，并通过 GRPO 目标更新策略。
papers.summary_en: Construct relative advantages from a group of responses to the same prompt and update the policy with the GRPO objective.
papers.scope: 选取论文的 GRPO 模块：组内相对优势、截断目标和回答级聚合。
papers.scope_en: Focus on the paper's GRPO module: group-relative advantages, clipped objectives, and response-level aggregation.

papers.title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
papers.authors: Zichen Liu, Changyu Chen, Wenjun Li, Penghui Qi, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, Wee Sun Lee, Min Lin
papers.summary: 分析 GRPO 的长度与难度偏差，并调整优势缩放和损失归一化。
papers.summary_en: Analyze length and difficulty biases in GRPO and adjust advantage scaling and loss normalization.
papers.scope: 实现去除组内标准差缩放与固定生成长度归一化这两处修正。
papers.scope_en: Implement two corrections: remove group standard-deviation scaling and normalize by a fixed generation budget.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.authors: Jonathan Ho, Ajay Jain, Pieter Abbeel
papers.summary: 用逐步加噪的前向过程和学习去噪的反向过程构造生成模型。
papers.summary_en: Build a generative model from a forward noising process and a learned reverse denoising process.
papers.scope: 实现闭式前向加噪，以及高斯后验和 epsilon 参数化的反向一步；调度器与采样循环已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement closed-form forward noising, the Gaussian posterior, and an epsilon-parameterized reverse step; schedules and sampling loops are supplied.

papers.title: Progressive Distillation for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
papers.summary: 把教师的两步确定性更新蒸馏为学生的一步更新，逐轮减少采样步数。
papers.summary_en: Distill two deterministic teacher steps into one student step, progressively reducing the sampling budget.
papers.scope: 先实现 v 参数化转换，再推导两步教师到一步学生的蒸馏目标并验证更新。
papers.scope_en: Implement v-parameterization conversions, then derive and validate the two-teacher-step to one-student-step distillation target.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
papers.authors: Jiaming Song, Chenlin Meng, Stefano Ermon
papers.summary: 使用非马尔可夫采样更新实现跳步生成，并以 eta 控制随机性。
papers.summary_en: Use a non-Markovian sampling update to skip timesteps, with eta controlling stochasticity.
papers.scope: 实现 DDIM 单步更新和干净端点；时间步选择、循环与反演探索代码已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the DDIM update and clean endpoint; timestep selection, loops, and inversion exploration code are supplied.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Yaron Lipman, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Heli Ben-Hamu, Maximilian Nickel, Matt Le
papers.summary: 通过回归条件概率路径的速度场学习连续生成流。
papers.summary_en: Learn a continuous generative flow by regressing the velocity field of conditional probability paths.
papers.scope: 实现条件路径、目标速度和 CFM 回归损失；时间采样、Euler 积分和训练辅助代码已提供。
papers.scope_en: Implement the conditional path, target velocity, and CFM regression loss; time sampling, Euler integration, and training helpers are supplied.

papers.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
papers.summary: 在回答级别构造长度归一化的重要性比率，再截断策略目标。
papers.summary_en: Construct length-normalized sequence importance ratios and clip the policy objective at the response level.
papers.scope: 实现序列概率比与 GSPO 损失，验证掩码、截断区域和梯度。
papers.scope_en: Implement sequence ratios and the GSPO loss; test masking, clipping regions, and gradients.

papers.title: On-policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes
papers.summary: 在学生自己生成的前缀上查询教师分布，减少训练与生成时的分布偏移。
papers.summary_en: Query the teacher on student-generated prefixes to reduce the mismatch between training and generation.
papers.scope: 实现学生 rollout 和全词表散度；在小型自回归模型上验证。OPD 在此指 on-policy distillation。
papers.scope_en: Implement student rollouts and full-vocabulary divergence in a tiny autoregressive model. OPD here means on-policy distillation.

papers.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
papers.summary: 通过动态保留有效回答组、非对称截断和 token 级聚合改进策略优化。
papers.summary_en: Improve policy optimization with informative-group filtering, asymmetric clipping, and token-level aggregation.
papers.scope: 实现组筛选与 token 级目标；采样系统和分布式训练不在本模块范围。
papers.scope_en: Implement group filtering and the token-level objective; sampling infrastructure and distributed training are outside this module.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: 冻结预训练权重，以低秩矩阵乘积学习增量。
papers.summary_en: Freeze pretrained weights and learn an update through a low-rank matrix product.
papers.scope: 实现低秩增量和线性前向，验证冻结边界及小型回归学习。
papers.scope_en: Implement the low-rank update and linear forward pass; verify frozen parameters and a small regression experiment.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.authors: Tim Dettmers, Artidoro Pagnoni, Ari Holtzman, Luke Zettlemoyer
papers.summary: 在量化的冻结基座上训练低秩适配器，以减少微调内存。
papers.summary_en: Train low-rank adapters on a quantized frozen base to reduce fine-tuning memory.
papers.scope: 实现分块 NF4 量化、反量化与适配器前向；不模拟双重量化或分页优化器。
papers.scope_en: Implement blockwise NF4 quantization, dequantization, and adapter forward; double quantization and paged optimizers are outside this exercise.

papers.title: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
papers.authors: Zhengyang Geng, Mingyang Deng, Xingjian Bai, J. Zico Kolter, Kaiming He
papers.summary: 用瞬时速度和平均速度之间的恒等式学习区间流，以一步生成样本。
papers.summary_en: Learn an interval flow using the identity between instantaneous and average velocities for one-step generation.
papers.scope: 实现平均流的 JVP 目标和梯度边界，并运行小型生成实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement the average-flow JVP target and gradient boundaries, then run a small generative experiment.

papers.title: Back to Basics: Let Denoising Generative Models Denoise
papers.summary: 直接预测干净数据，在不同预测空间和损失空间之间显式转换。
papers.summary_en: Predict clean data directly and explicitly convert between prediction and loss spaces.
papers.scope: 实现 x-prediction 到速度的转换与去噪目标，使用论文启发的低维流形嵌入实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement data-to-velocity conversion and the denoising objective with a paper-derived embedded-manifold experiment.

papers.title: Generative Modeling via Drifting
papers.authors: Mingyang Deng, He Li, Tianhong Li, Yilun Du, Kaiming He
papers.summary: 构造吸引真实样本、排斥生成样本的漂移场，并用停止梯度的目标训练生成器。
papers.summary_en: Construct a drifting field that attracts real samples and repels generated samples, then train a generator against a stopped-gradient target.
papers.scope: 实现漂移场与停止梯度损失，在小型二维分布上验证生成器行为。
papers.scope_en: Implement the drifting field and stopped-gradient loss, and verify generator behavior on a small two-dimensional distribution.

papers.title: One-step Diffusion with Distribution Matching Distillation
papers.authors: Tianwei Yin, Michaël Gharbi, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Fredo Durand, William T. Freeman, Taesung Park
papers.summary: 用真实分布和生成分布的 score 差构造生成器的分布匹配更新。
papers.summary_en: Use the score difference between real and generated distributions to construct a distribution-matching generator update.
papers.scope: 实现 score 差目标与配对回归项，用解析双峰分布检查模式覆盖。
papers.scope_en: Implement the score-difference target and paired regression term; inspect mode coverage using an analytic bimodal distribution.

papers.title: Improved Distribution Matching Distillation for Fast Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Tianwei Yin, Michaël Gharbi, Taesung Park, Richard Zhang, Eli Shechtman, Fredo Durand, William T. Freeman
papers.summary: 通过更快的假 score 更新和对抗辅助训练，去除 DMD 的配对回归要求。
papers.summary_en: Remove DMD's paired-regression requirement using faster fake-score updates and adversarial auxiliary training.
papers.scope: 实现双时间尺度更新与辅助目标，在小型实验中验证参数更新边界。
papers.scope_en: Implement two-timescale updates and auxiliary objectives; verify parameter-update boundaries in a small experiment.

papers.title: Consistency Models
papers.authors: Yang Song, Prafulla Dhariwal, Mark Chen, Ilya Sutskever
papers.summary: 让同一生成轨迹上的不同噪声状态映射到一致的干净端点。
papers.summary_en: Map noisy states along the same generative trajectory to a consistent clean endpoint.
papers.scope: 实现边界参数化和相邻时刻的一致性蒸馏损失。
papers.scope_en: Implement the boundary parameterization and adjacent-time consistency-distillation loss.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: 用多头注意力组合序列信息，结合位置编码、逐位置前馈网络和残差归一化构成 Transformer。
papers.summary_en: Combine sequence information through multi-head attention, positional encoding, position-wise feed-forward networks, and residual normalization.
papers.scope: 分别实现缩放点积注意力、多头注意力、LayerNorm 与 Add & Norm、正弦位置编码及逐位置前馈网络；每个模块独立练习，辅助代码与小实验已提供。
papers.scope_en: Independently implement scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, LayerNorm and Add & Norm, sinusoidal positional encoding, and position-wise feed-forward networks; helpers and small experiments are supplied.

papers.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
papers.summary: 将权重衰减与自适应梯度更新分离。
papers.summary_en: Decouple weight decay from the adaptive gradient update.
papers.scope: 实现矩估计、偏差修正与解耦权重衰减的一步更新。
papers.scope_en: Implement moment estimates, bias correction, and a decoupled weight-decay step.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.authors: Tri Dao, Daniel Y. Fu, Stefano Ermon, Atri Rudra, Christopher Ré
papers.summary: 利用在线 softmax 分块精确累积注意力，避免物化完整注意力矩阵。
papers.summary_en: Accumulate exact attention in blocks with online softmax without materializing the full attention matrix.
papers.scope: 实现分块递推与重缩放。这是 CPU 算法练习，不评价 GPU kernel 性能。
papers.scope_en: Implement blockwise recurrence and rescaling. This CPU algorithm exercise does not benchmark GPU kernels.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.summary: 用对称的批内对比损失对齐图像和文本表征。
papers.summary_en: Align image and text representations using a symmetric in-batch contrastive objective.
papers.scope: 实现特征归一化、温度缩放和双向对比损失，使用小型配对检索实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement feature normalization, temperature scaling, and bidirectional contrastive loss with a tiny paired-retrieval experiment.

papers.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
papers.summary: 从 GLM-5 技术报告中提取按注意力头正交化的优化更新，以及异步强化学习的重要性采样修正。
papers.summary_en: Extract head-wise orthogonalized updates and asynchronous-RL importance corrections from the GLM-5 technical report.
papers.scope: 两题分别实现 Muon Split 的逐头正交化与双边重要性采样策略损失，使用可复现的 CPU 教学实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement Muon Split's per-head orthogonalization and a double-sided importance-sampling policy loss in two independent CPU exercises.

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
papers.summary: 实现 Kimi K3 在序列、深度和激活值三个维度的核心机制：KDA、块级注意力残差与 SiTU-GLU。
papers.summary_en: Implement Kimi K3's core mechanisms for sequence mixing, depth aggregation, and bounded activations: KDA, Block AttnRes, and SiTU-GLU.
papers.scope: 三题分别实现有界衰减与 delta-rule 递推、跨层残差注意力聚合、SiTU 门控激活，并重绘论文中的门函数与激活曲线。
papers.scope_en: Independently implement bounded decay and delta-rule recurrence, attention over residual blocks, and SiTU gating; recreate the report's decay and activation curves.

papers.title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.summary: 用同一模型的特权上下文教师监督学生自己的轨迹。
papers.summary_en: Use a privileged-context teacher from the same model to supervise student rollouts.
papers.scope: 双上下文因果对齐与逐词表项散度截断。
papers.scope_en: Dual-context causal alignment and pointwise divergence clipping.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning via Self-Distillation
papers.summary: 将环境反馈与成功尝试转成逐 token 的自蒸馏监督。
papers.summary_en: Turn environment feedback and successful attempts into token-level self-distillation.
papers.scope: 同题反馈路由、reverse KL 与 top-k 尾部概率聚合。
papers.scope_en: Same-question feedback routing, reverse KL, and top-k tail-mass coarsening.

papers.title: Representation Alignment for Generation: Training Diffusion Transformers Is Easier Than You Think
papers.summary: 将生成模型的中间特征与冻结教师的语义表征对齐。
papers.summary_en: Align intermediate generative features with a frozen semantic teacher.
papers.scope: 逐 patch 表征对齐损失与梯度边界。
papers.scope_en: Patch-wise representation alignment and gradient boundaries.

papers.title: Restructuring Vector Quantization with the Rotation Trick
papers.summary: 以冻结旋转与缩放构造向量量化的代理梯度。
papers.summary_en: Use a frozen rotation and scale to construct vector-quantization surrogate gradients.
papers.scope: 保持量化前向值的旋转梯度变换。
papers.scope_en: Rotation-based gradient transformation with quantized forward values.

papers.title: Differential Transformer
papers.summary: 相减两张注意力图以抑制共有噪声。
papers.summary_en: Subtract two attention maps to suppress common-mode noise.
papers.scope: 已投影张量上的差分注意力与 lambda 参数化。
papers.scope_en: Differential attention on projected tensors and lambda parameterization.

papers.title: Block Diffusion: Interpolating Between Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: 以块间自回归和块内扩散结合离散生成。
papers.summary_en: Combine autoregression across blocks with diffusion within blocks.
papers.scope: 拼接干净和含噪 token 的单次前向注意力掩码。
papers.scope_en: Single-forward attention masks for concatenated noisy and clean tokens.

papers.title: DistiLLM-2: A Contrastive Approach Boosts the Distillation of LLMs
papers.summary: 在教师与学生生成的数据上分别使用不同的蒸馏方向。
papers.summary_en: Use distinct distillation directions on teacher- and student-generated responses.
papers.scope: 教师轨迹的 skew KL 与学生轨迹的 skew reverse KL。
papers.scope_en: Skew KL on teacher trajectories and skew reverse KL on student trajectories.

papers.title: Pass@K Policy Optimization: Solving Harder Reinforcement Learning Problems
papers.summary: 将 pass@k 目标的奖励变换用于策略梯度训练。
papers.summary_en: Transform rewards to optimize a pass@k policy-gradient objective.
papers.scope: 连续奖励变换、policy loss 与论文的一维 Gaussian toy。
papers.scope_en: Continuous-reward transformation, policy loss, and the paper’s one-dimensional Gaussian toy.

papers.title: SVDQuant: Absorbing Outliers by Low-Rank Components for 4-Bit Diffusion Models
papers.summary: 用高精度低秩支路吸收量化困难成分，再量化残差。
papers.summary_en: Absorb difficult-to-quantize components in a high-precision low-rank branch and quantize the residual.
papers.scope: 平滑、SVD 低秩分解与 4-bit 残差前向。
papers.scope_en: Smoothing, SVD low-rank decomposition, and a 4-bit residual forward pass.

papers.title: MoGe: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images with Optimal Training Supervision
papers.summary: 通过鲁棒几何对齐处理单目预测中的尺度与深度偏移。
papers.summary_en: Use robust geometric alignment to handle scale and depth-shift ambiguity in monocular predictions.
papers.scope: 截断加权 L1 的鲁棒最优估计。
papers.scope_en: Robust optimal estimation with truncated weighted L1 residuals.

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Inverse Problem Solving with Decoupled Noise Annealing
papers.summary: 将干净空间的测量一致性优化与重新加噪解耦。
papers.summary_en: Decouple measurement-consistency updates in clean space from renoising.
papers.scope: 线性 Gaussian 后验 score、Langevin 与独立重新加噪。
papers.scope_en: Linear-Gaussian posterior score, Langevin updates, and independent renoising.

papers.title: DiffusionNFT: Online Diffusion Reinforcement with Forward Process
papers.summary: 从反馈构造正负隐式速度场，优化扩散模型。
papers.summary_en: Construct positive and negative implicit velocity fields from feedback to optimize diffusion models.
papers.scope: 正负 beta 隐式速度、双分支目标与微型训练。
papers.scope_en: Positive/negative beta implicit velocities, the two-branch objective, and tiny training.

papers.title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
papers.summary: 按从粗到细的尺度顺序生成视觉 token，并在同一尺度内并行预测。
papers.summary_en: Generate visual tokens from coarse to fine, predicting tokens within each scale in parallel.
papers.scope: 下一尺度的条件输入与注意力掩码，以及多尺度残差量化与重建。
papers.scope_en: Next-scale conditioning and attention masks, plus multiscale residual quantization and reconstruction.

papers.title: Representation Fréchet Loss for Visual Generation
papers.authors: Jiawei Yang, Zhengyang Geng, Xuan Ju, Yonglong Tian, Yue Wang
papers.summary: 以历史特征统计估计更大的样本总体，只对当前 batch 反传 Fréchet 距离。
papers.summary_en: Estimate a larger feature population from historical statistics while backpropagating Fréchet distance through the current batch only.
papers.scope: 原始一阶与二阶矩的 EMA、协方差恢复、可微 Fréchet 距离和多表征损失归一化。
papers.scope_en: EMA of raw first and second moments, covariance recovery, differentiable Fréchet distance, and multi-representation loss normalization.

papers.title: VICReg: Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.authors: Adrien Bardes, Jean Ponce, Yann LeCun
papers.summary: 用方差、视图一致性与去相关约束学习表征。
papers.summary_en: Learn representations with variance, view invariance, and decorrelation constraints.
papers.scope: 三项损失的批统计、权重与梯度。
papers.scope_en: Batch statistics, weights, and gradients of the three loss terms.

papers.title: LeJEPA: Provable and Scalable Self-Supervised Learning Without the Heuristics
papers.summary: 用随机投影上的高斯性约束学习各向同性表征。
papers.summary_en: Learn isotropic representations with Gaussianity constraints on random projections.
papers.scope: SIGReg 的特征函数检验、数值积分与切片聚合。
papers.scope_en: SIGReg characteristic-function statistics, numerical integration, and slice aggregation.

papers.title: VISReg: Variance-Invariance-Sketching Regularization for JEPA training
papers.authors: Haiyu Wu, Randall Balestriero, Morgan Levine
papers.summary: 分离表征的尺度与分布形状，用切片匹配约束高斯性。
papers.summary_en: Separate representation scale and distribution shape with sliced Gaussian matching.
papers.scope: 尺度、切片形状、中心与多视图一致性损失。
papers.scope_en: Scale, sliced shape, centering, and multi-view invariance losses.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.authors: Mahmoud Assran, Quentin Duval, Ishan Misra, Piotr Bojanowski, Pascal Vincent, Michael Rabbat, Yann LeCun, Nicolas Ballas
papers.summary: 从上下文预测被遮挡图像块的教师表征。
papers.summary_en: Predict teacher representations of masked image blocks from context.
papers.scope: 目标块提取、预测损失与 EMA 教师更新。
papers.scope_en: Target-block gathering, prediction loss, and EMA teacher updates.

papers.title: LeWorldModel: Stable End-to-End Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture from Pixels
papers.authors: Lucas Maes, Quentin Le Lidec, Damien Scieur, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero
papers.summary: 联合学习动作条件潜空间预测，并用潜空间 rollout 规划动作。
papers.summary_en: Jointly learn action-conditioned latent predictions and plan actions with latent rollouts.
papers.scope: 可微预测与正则目标、自回归 rollout、终点代价和 CEM 精英重拟合。
papers.scope_en: Differentiable prediction and regularization, autoregressive rollout, terminal cost, and CEM elite refitting.

papers.title: Causal-JEPA: Learning World Models through Object-Level Latent Masking
papers.authors: Heejeong Nam, Quentin Le Lidec, Lucas Maes, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero
papers.summary: 遮挡对象的潜空间轨迹，让模型从其他对象推断其动态。
papers.summary_en: Mask object-level latent trajectories to infer their dynamics from other objects.
papers.scope: 保留初始身份锚点的对象遮挡与历史、未来预测损失。
papers.scope_en: Object masking with initial identity anchors and history/future prediction losses.

papers.title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization
papers.summary: 用均方根代替去均值的归一化，并研究部分特征统计。
papers.summary_en: Normalize by root mean square without centering and explore partial feature statistics.
papers.scope: 实现 RMSNorm 和前 k 特征的 pRMSNorm，检查尺度关系与跨特征梯度。
papers.scope_en: Implement RMSNorm and first-k pRMSNorm; check scale identities and cross-feature gradients.

papers.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
papers.authors: Joshua Ainslie, James Lee-Thorp, Michiel de Jong, Yury Zemlyanskiy, Federico Lebrón, and Sumit Sanghai
papers.summary: 让连续的一组 query 头共享 KV 头，并用组内投影均值转换已有多头结构。
papers.summary_en: Share KV heads across contiguous query groups and convert multi-head projections by group-wise averaging.
papers.scope: 实现 KV 投影均值池化与分组注意力，验证共享梯度和缓存容量关系。
papers.scope_en: Implement KV projection mean pooling and grouped attention; verify shared gradients and cache capacity.

papers.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
papers.authors: Jianlin Su, Yu Lu, Shengfeng Pan, Ahmed Murtadha, Bo Wen, and Yunfeng Liu

papers.scope: 实现完整维度的 RoPE，验证方向、频率、梯度和分块缓存的绝对位置。
papers.scope_en: Implement full-width RoPE; verify direction, frequencies, gradients and absolute offsets in chunked caches.

papers.title: Recommender Systems with Generative Retrieval

papers.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT

papers.title: BPR: Bayesian Personalized Ranking from Implicit Feedback

papers.title: LightGCN: Simplifying and Powering Graph Convolution Network for Recommendation
papers.authors: Xiangnan He, Kuan Deng, Xiang Wang, Yan Li, Yongdong Zhang and Meng Wang
papers.summary: 用对称归一化的用户—物品图传播协同信号，并聚合包含初始层的多跳表示。
papers.summary_en: Propagate collaborative signals through a symmetrically normalized user-item graph and aggregate multiple layers including initial embeddings.
papers.scope: 稠密二部图、线性传播与均匀层聚合，以及 160 次真实合成训练；不复现大规模稀疏训练或论文数据基准。
papers.scope_en: Dense bipartite graphs, linear propagation, uniform layer aggregation and 160 actual synthetic training updates; no large sparse training or paper dataset benchmark.

papers.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
papers.authors: Ting Chen, Simon Kornblith, Mohammad Norouzi, Geoffrey Hinton
papers.summary: 用 2B 个锚点实现 NT-Xent，理解正样本映射、自身掩码、同视图负样本与温度。
papers.summary_en: Implement NT-Xent over 2B anchors with positive-pair mapping, self masking, same-view negatives and temperature.
papers.scope: 归一化对比损失、独立梯度检查及 6 对向量的真实 CPU 训练；不复现图像训练或论文基准。
papers.scope_en: Normalized contrastive loss, independent gradient checks and actual CPU training on 6 vector pairs; no image-training or paper benchmark reproduction.

papers.title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
papers.authors: Kaiming He, Haoqi Fan, Yuxin Wu, Saining Xie, Ross Girshick
papers.summary: 用动量编码器和跨 batch 负样本队列构建一致的对比字典。
papers.summary_en: Build a consistent contrastive dictionary with a momentum encoder and cross-batch negative queue.
papers.scope: Query-only InfoNCE、参数 EMA 和环形字典；提供 12 次真实合成 SGD，不复现图像训练或论文基准。
papers.scope_en: Query-only InfoNCE, parameter EMA and a circular dictionary, with 12 actual synthetic SGD steps; no image-training or paper benchmark reproduction.

papers.title: LLM Training and Generation: Small Implementation Exercises
papers.short_title: LLM Training & Generation · 训练与生成入门
papers.authors: PaperLeet original curriculum; primary documentation linked per exercise
papers.summary: 从下一词预测与回答掩码，到候选概率、有效 token 梯度累积和全局裁剪。
papers.summary_en: From next-token targets and response masks to candidate probabilities, token-weighted accumulation and global clipping.
papers.scope: 7 道独立基础题，明确错位、掩码、并列值和归约约定；提供确定性概率实验与真实小模型梯度更新。
papers.scope_en: Seven standalone exercises with explicit shifting, masks, ties and reductions; deterministic probability experiments and actual small-model gradient updates.

papers.title: Group Normalization
papers.summary: 在每个样本内按连续通道分组归一化，研究批次组成与组数的影响。
papers.summary_en: Normalize contiguous channel groups within each sample and explore batch composition and group counts.
papers.scope: 实现可微的分组统计与逐通道仿射参数；提供标量基准、梯度检查和无需训练的合成实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement differentiable grouped moments and per-channel affine; scalar oracles, gradient checks and a training-free synthetic experiment are supplied.

papers.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
papers.authors: Ari Holtzman, Jan Buys, Li Du, Maxwell Forbes, Yejin Choi
papers.summary: 从动态核集合的重归一化概率中抽取下一个词表 token。
papers.summary_en: Draw the next vocabulary token from the renormalized distribution over a dynamic nucleus.
papers.scope: 提供核概率 helper，练习逆 CDF、词表索引和调用方随机数流；用 8192 次真实合成抽样验证。
papers.scope_en: A nucleus-probability helper is provided; practice inverse-CDF draws, vocabulary IDs and caller-owned RNG with 8192 actual synthetic samples.

papers.title: Overcoming catastrophic forgetting in neural networks
papers.summary: 用 Fisher 对角加权的参数锚点约束，理解学习新任务与保留旧任务的权衡。
papers.summary_en: Use a Fisher-diagonal parameter anchor to study the tradeoff between new-task learning and old-task retention.
papers.scope: 给定旧参数和 Fisher 权重，实现 EWC 惩罚与正确梯度；用两任务合成训练观察权衡。
papers.scope_en: Given old parameters and Fisher weights, implement the EWC penalty and its gradients, then observe the tradeoff in synthetic two-task training.

papers.title: Gradient Episodic Memory for Continual Learning
papers.summary: 从任务评估矩阵计算准确率、前向和后向迁移，区分迁移与历史峰值遗忘。
papers.summary_en: Compute accuracy and forward/backward transfer from a task evaluation matrix, separating transfer from peak-based forgetting.
papers.scope: 实现 GEM 的 ACC、BWT、FWT 及明确标注的历史峰值遗忘扩展；不实现 GEM 梯度投影算法。
papers.scope_en: Implement GEM's ACC, BWT and FWT plus an explicitly defined peak-forgetting extension; GEM gradient projection is outside this exercise.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.authors: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, Jian Sun
papers.summary: 实现两层残差分支、恒等或投影捷径，以及相加后的 ReLU。
papers.summary_en: Implement a two-layer residual branch, identity or projection shortcut, and post-addition ReLU.
papers.scope: 补全一个矩阵版本的残差块；提供四块网络的合成回归实验，不包含卷积、BN 或完整 ResNet 训练。
papers.scope_en: Complete one matrix residual block; a four-block synthetic regression experiment is supplied. Convolutions, BN and full ResNet training are outside scope.

papers.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
papers.summary: 区分训练归一化的总体方差与移动估计使用的无偏方差，并实现冻结统计量的推理。
papers.summary_en: Distinguish population variance for training normalization from unbiased running estimates, then implement frozen-statistics inference.
papers.scope: 补全一个纯函数，返回输出和下一组统计量；提供仿射参数训练与推理独立性实验，不复现 ImageNet 结果。
papers.scope_en: Complete a pure function returning output and next statistics; affine training and inference-independence experiments are supplied, without reproducing ImageNet results.

papers.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
papers.summary: 实现可微高斯采样、对标准正态的解析 KL，以及稳定的 Bernoulli 负 ELBO。
papers.summary_en: Implement differentiable Gaussian sampling, analytic KL to a standard normal and a stable Bernoulli negative ELBO.
papers.scope: 补全三个函数；编码器、解码器和合成二值模式的 120 步训练由实验提供，不复现 MNIST 或图像生成指标。
papers.scope_en: Complete three functions; the supplied encoder/decoder train for 120 steps on synthetic binary patterns. No MNIST or image-generation benchmark is reproduced.

papers.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
papers.authors: William L. Hamilton, Rex Ying and Jure Leskovec
papers.summary: 聚合采样邻域并学习共享特征变换，将编码器迁移到训练时未见的图。
papers.summary_en: Aggregate sampled neighborhoods with shared feature transformations and transfer the encoder to an unseen graph.
papers.scope: 实现 Algorithm 1 均值编码、逐跳归一化与梯度；提供 100 次真实合成训练和独立图评估，不复现完整 TensorFlow 配置或论文数据基准。
papers.scope_en: Algorithm 1 mean encoding, per-hop normalization and gradients; 100 actual synthetic training updates and evaluation on a distinct graph, without reproducing the full TensorFlow configuration or paper benchmarks.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.authors: Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee, Kristina Toutanova
papers.summary: 实现选中词的 80/10/10 替换、原词标签，以及只对选中位置求均值的稳定交叉熵。
papers.summary_en: Implement 80/10/10 selected-token corruption, original-token labels and stable cross entropy averaged only over selected positions.
papers.scope: 补全数据替换与 MLM 损失；提供双向上下文表的合成训练，不包含 Transformer、NSP、分词或语言基准复现。
papers.scope_en: Complete corruption and the MLM loss; a supplied bidirectional context table trains on synthetic triples. Transformer, NSP, tokenization and language benchmarks are outside scope.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
papers.authors: Ian J. Goodfellow, Jean Pouget-Abadie, Mehdi Mirza, Bing Xu, David Warde-Farley, Sherjil Ozair, Aaron Courville, Yoshua Bengio
papers.summary: 实现判别器的两个独立期望，以及稳定、可微的非饱和生成器目标。
papers.summary_en: Implement the discriminator's two independently averaged expectations and the stable differentiable non-saturating generator objective.
papers.scope: 补全 logits 损失；提供一维高斯位置的真实交替训练，不实现图像 GAN、完整网络或稳定收敛保证。
papers.scope_en: Complete logit losses; a supplied one-dimensional Gaussian location game performs actual alternating training. Image GANs, complete networks and convergence guarantees are outside scope.

papers.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
papers.authors: Nitish Srivastava, Geoffrey Hinton, Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever, Ruslan Salakhutdinov
papers.summary: 实现显式保留掩码的反向缩放 Dropout，区分训练、推理和两个概率端点。
papers.summary_en: Implement explicitly masked inverted dropout, distinguishing training, inference and both probability endpoints.
papers.scope: 补全一个逐元素函数；提供实际掩码训练、Monte Carlo 均值与方差实验，不证明泛化收益或复现图像基准。
papers.scope_en: Complete one element-wise function; actual masked training and Monte Carlo moments are supplied, without a generalization claim or image benchmark reproduction.

papers.title: Evolution Strategies at Scale: LLM Fine-Tuning Beyond Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Xin Qiu, Yulu Gan et al.
papers.summary: 按奖励组合随机参数扰动。
papers.summary_en: Reward-weighted parameter perturbations.
papers.scope: 奖励标准化与 ES 更新。
papers.scope_en: Reward standardization and ES updates.

papers.title: Decorate the Newcomers: Visual Domain Prompt for Continual Test Time Adaptation
papers.summary: 冻结模型，学习视觉提示。
papers.summary_en: Adapt visual prompts with a frozen model.
papers.scope: 提示叠加、历史因子与稳态正则。
papers.scope_en: Prompt addition, historical factors and homeostatic regularization.

papers.title: Neural Thickets: Diverse Task Experts Are Dense Around Pretrained Weights
papers.summary: 随机搜索专家，集成预测。
papers.summary_en: Select random experts and ensemble predictions.
papers.scope: 参数扰动、专家筛选与多数投票。
papers.scope_en: Parameter perturbation, expert selection and majority voting.

papers.title: R-Zero: Self-Evolving Reasoning LLM from Zero Data
papers.authors: Chengsong Huang, Wenhao Yu et al.
papers.summary: 文本出题者与解题者交替进化。
papers.summary_en: Co-evolve a text challenger and solver.
papers.scope: R-Zero 出题奖励；R-Zero 伪标签与课程
papers.scope_en: R-Zero Challenger Rewards; R-Zero Pseudo-Labels and Curriculum

papers.title: G-Zero: Self-Play for Open-Ended Generation from Zero Data
papers.authors: Chengsong Huang, Haolin Liu et al.
papers.summary: 以提示概率差驱动开放式自演化。
papers.summary_en: Drive open-ended self-play with hint-induced probability shifts.
papers.scope: G-Zero 提示概率差；G-Zero 偏好样本筛选
papers.scope_en: G-Zero Hint-Delta; G-Zero Preference Curation

papers.title: VisPlay: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models from Images
papers.authors: Yicheng He, Chengsong Huang, Zongxia Li et al.
papers.summary: 从无标注图像构造视觉课程。
papers.summary_en: Build a visual curriculum from unlabeled images.
papers.scope: VisPlay 图像分组奖励
papers.scope_en: VisPlay Image-Grouped Rewards

papers.title: MM-Zero: Self-Evolving Multi-Model Vision Language Models From Zero Data
papers.authors: Zongxia Li, Hongyang Du, Chengsong Huang et al.
papers.summary: 出题、渲染、解题三个角色共同演化。
papers.summary_en: Co-evolve proposer, renderer and multimodal solver.
papers.scope: MM-Zero 视觉课程奖励；MM-Zero 编码与解题反馈
papers.scope_en: MM-Zero Visual Curriculum Rewards; MM-Zero Coder and Solver Feedback

papers.title: Hierarchical organization of modularity in metabolic networks
papers.authors: E. Ravasz, A. L. Somera, D. A. Mongru, Z. N. Oltvai and A.-L. Barabási
papers.summary: 通过模块度与贪心社区发现理解代谢网络中的模块化组织。
papers.summary_en: Study modular organization in metabolic networks through modularity scoring and greedy community detection.
papers.scope: 实现模块度计算与确定性贪心社区发现；练习范围不复现论文中的完整层次结构或真实代谢网络结果。
papers.scope_en: Implement modularity scoring and deterministic greedy community detection; this exercise does not reproduce the paper's full hierarchy or results on real metabolic networks.

papers.title: Network biology: understanding the cell's functional organization
papers.authors: Albert-László Barabási and Zoltán N. Oltvai
papers.summary: 使用图结构与网络测量描述细胞网络的功能组织。
papers.summary_en: Use graph structure and network measures to describe the functional organization of cellular networks.
papers.scope: 包含连通分量、最大连通分量、节点中心性与候选枢纽排名；图结构指标不等于生物学功能或必需性的实验证据。
papers.scope_en: Covers connected components, largest components, node centrality and candidate-hub ranking; graph metrics are not experimental evidence of biological function or essentiality.

papers.title: Scale-free networks in cell biology
papers.summary: 计算生物互作网络的节点度与度分布，理解网络拓扑描述符。
papers.summary_en: Compute node degrees and degree distributions in biological interaction networks and understand these topological descriptors.
papers.scope: 实现简单无向图的节点度与度分布；合成网络练习不证明真实生物网络服从无标度分布。
papers.scope_en: Implement node degrees and degree distributions on simple undirected graphs; synthetic-network exercises do not establish that real biological networks are scale-free.

papers.title: Network motifs: simple building blocks of complex networks
papers.authors: R. Milo, S. Shen-Orr, S. Itzkovitz, N. Kashtan, D. Chklovskii and U. Alon
papers.summary: 在有向调控网络中识别前馈环，并理解网络模体的结构定义。
papers.summary_en: Identify feed-forward loops in directed regulatory networks and understand the structural definition of network motifs.
papers.scope: 实现前馈环子图匹配；计数比较不等于统计显著性检验，也不证明调控功能。
papers.scope_en: Implement feed-forward-loop subgraph matching; count comparisons are not statistical significance tests and do not prove regulatory function.

papers.title: Uncovering disease-disease relationships through the incomplete interactome
papers.authors: Jörg Menche, Amitabh Sharma, Maksim Kitsak, Susan Dina Ghiassian, Marc Vidal, Joseph Loscalzo and Albert-László Barabási
papers.summary: 使用无权最短路径研究互作网络中的节点邻近性。
papers.summary_en: Use unweighted shortest paths to study node proximity in interaction networks.
papers.scope: 实现单源距离、两点最短路径长度与具体最短路径；不复现论文的疾病模块分离度量或真实疾病关联分析。
papers.scope_en: Implement single-source distances, pairwise shortest-path lengths and explicit shortest paths; this does not reproduce the paper's disease-module separation measure or real disease-association analysis.

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.summary: 将动作序列建模为条件扩散过程，并滚动执行预测序列中的短动作片段。
papers.summary_en: Model action sequences with conditional diffusion and execute short chunks with receding-horizon control.
papers.scope: 实现动作前向加噪、噪声回归损失与动作片段索引，运行小型 CPU 动作学习实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement action noising, noise-regression loss and execution-chunk indexing, with a small CPU action-learning experiment.

papers.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
papers.summary: 在可微世界模型中展开策略，使用软生存概率和价值自举学习控制行为。
papers.summary_en: Unroll a policy through a differentiable world model, using soft survival probabilities and value bootstrapping to learn control.
papers.scope: 实现软生存加权的可微回报与冻结的 lambda-return 目标，并在微型动力学中更新策略。
papers.scope_en: Implement differentiable soft-survival returns and frozen lambda-return targets, then update a policy through tiny dynamics.

papers.title: Diffusion Model Alignment Using Direct Preference Optimization
papers.summary: 用偏好对上的去噪误差差值构造扩散模型的直接偏好优化目标。
papers.summary_en: Optimize diffusion-model preferences using differences in denoising errors on preferred and rejected samples.
papers.scope: 实现偏好对共享加噪与参考模型校正的 DPO 损失，验证偏好方向和冻结梯度。
papers.scope_en: Implement shared pair noising and reference-corrected DPO loss; verify preference direction and gradient boundaries.

papers.title: Flow-GRPO: Training Flow Matching Models via Online RL
papers.summary: 将生成流转化为随机转移，通过组相对优势和截断策略目标优化生成奖励。
papers.summary_en: Convert a generative flow into stochastic transitions and optimize rewards with group-relative advantages and a clipped policy objective.
papers.scope: 实现反向时间 SDE 转移、高斯策略比率、组内优势和 KL 正则，运行小型奖励优化实验。
papers.scope_en: Implement reverse-time SDE transitions, Gaussian policy ratios, within-group advantages and KL regularization, with a small reward-optimization experiment.

papers.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
papers.authors: Xiaohua Zhai, Basil Mustafa, Alexander Kolesnikov, Lucas Beyer
papers.summary: 用逐图文对的 sigmoid 目标学习图像与文本的共享表征。
papers.summary_en: Learn shared image-text representations with a pairwise sigmoid objective.
papers.scope: 实现归一化图文 logits 与按 batch 大小归约的 sigmoid 损失，验证配对关系、缩放与梯度。
papers.scope_en: Implement normalized image-text logits and batch-normalized sigmoid loss; verify pair assignments, scaling and gradients.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.summary: 通过块表将逻辑 token 映射到物理 KV 缓存块，使注意力读取无需连续内存。
papers.summary_en: Map logical tokens to physical KV-cache blocks through block tables so attention can read noncontiguous storage.
papers.scope: 实现分页 KV 读取和批量单 token 注意力，验证共享块、尾块掩码和物理重排不变性。
papers.scope_en: Implement paged KV gathering and batched single-token attention; verify shared blocks, partial-block masking and invariance to physical layout.

papers.title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
papers.summary: 用大规模含噪图文配对训练双编码器，比较数据规模与清洗方式。
papers.summary_en: Train dual encoders on large-scale noisy image-text pairs to study the roles of data scale and filtering.
papers.scope: 归一化双编码器特征、可微温度与双向 batch softmax；以合成图文配对演示训练，不包含含噪网络数据采集。
papers.scope_en: Normalized dual-encoder features, differentiable temperature, and bidirectional batch softmax; train synthetic image-text pairs without web-scale noisy-data collection.

papers.title: SigLIP 2: Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders with Improved Semantic Understanding, Localization, and Dense Features
papers.summary: 将描述生成、自蒸馏、掩码预测和在线数据筛选纳入表征学习。
papers.summary_en: Combine captioning, self-distillation, masked prediction, and online data curation to improve visual representations.
papers.scope: 实现 SigLIP 2 辅助掩码预测中的概率蒸馏核；teacher 概率已给定，不实现 EMA 编码器、增强、投影头或完整多目标训练。
papers.scope_en: Implement the probability-distillation kernel of SigLIP 2 masked prediction with supplied teacher targets; exclude EMA encoders, augmentation, projection heads, and the full training recipe.

papers.title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
papers.summary: 用生成与过滤改善图文监督，同时支持理解与生成。
papers.summary_en: Improve image-text supervision through caption generation and filtering while supporting both understanding and generation.
papers.scope: 实现 BLIP 一个检索方向的动量软标签蒸馏；支持非方形负样本队列，不实现队列更新、动量编码器或 CapFilt 数据生成。
papers.scope_en: Implement BLIP momentum soft-target distillation for one retrieval direction with rectangular negative queues; omit queue updates, momentum encoders, and CapFilt data generation.

papers.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
papers.summary: 用 Q-Former 连接冻结视觉编码器和语言模型；适合练习查询 token 与跨注意力。
papers.summary_en: Connect frozen image encoders and language models with a Q-Former, exposing query tokens and cross-attention as exercise components.
papers.scope: Q-Former 输出的归一化、逐文本 max-query 相似度与梯度路由；不包含 Transformer 或冻结大模型。
papers.scope_en: Normalize Q-Former outputs, compute per-text maximum-query similarities, and route gradients through winning queries; omit Transformer and frozen large-model execution.

papers.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
papers.summary: 连接预训练视觉与语言模型，处理交错图文和少样本上下文。
papers.summary_en: Connect pretrained vision and language models to handle interleaved image-text inputs and few-shot context.
papers.scope: 最近媒体掩码、无媒体行的安全 softmax 和零初始化 tanh 门控；简化为单头恒等投影的交叉注意力。
papers.scope_en: Immediately preceding media masks, safe softmax for rows without media, and zero-initialized tanh gating in single-head identity-projection cross-attention.

papers.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
papers.summary: 视觉编码器与语言模型连接，并用视觉指令数据训练。
papers.summary_en: Connect a vision encoder to a language model and train the combined model on visual instruction data.
papers.scope: 单图单样本的视觉序列打包与监督标签对齐；输入特征已经投影，不实现视觉编码器、语言模型或训练数据构建。
papers.scope_en: Pack one image into one sample and align supervision labels; features are already projected, excluding the vision encoder, language model, and data construction.

papers.title: InstructBLIP: Towards General-purpose Vision-Language Models with Instruction Tuning
papers.summary: 让视觉特征提取依赖指令，比较指令感知与固定特征查询。
papers.summary_en: Condition visual feature extraction on instructions to compare instruction-aware queries with fixed feature queries.
papers.scope: 恒等投影的两级查询自注意力和视觉交叉注意力，验证指令影响与 padding 隔离；不声称复现完整 Q-Former。
papers.scope_en: Two-stage query self-attention and visual cross-attention with identity projections, testing instruction influence and padding isolation; not a full Q-Former reproduction.

papers.title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
papers.summary: 以图像配对为桥梁，将文本、音频、深度、热成像、IMU 等模态对齐。
papers.summary_en: Use image-paired data to align text, audio, depth, thermal images, and IMU signals in one embedding space.
papers.scope: 多模态共用图像锚点的配对图和归约；以合成模态演示无需非图像配对的对齐，不复现六种编码器。
papers.scope_en: Implement the image-anchored pairing graph and reduction across modalities; align synthetic modalities without direct nonimage pairs, excluding the six encoders.

papers.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
papers.summary: 将图像与文本 token 提前融合，统一理解与混合模态生成。
papers.summary_en: Fuse image and text tokens early to support unified understanding and mixed-modal generation.
papers.scope: 逐头 LayerNorm 的统计轴、总体方差和仿射参数；用注意力熵实验观察输入范数增长下的稳定性。
papers.scope_en: Per-head LayerNorm statistics, population variance, and affine parameters, with an attention-entropy experiment under growing input norms.

papers.title: Qwen2-VL: Enhancing Vision-Language Model's Perception of the World at Any Resolution
papers.summary: 动态分辨率与多模态 RoPE；适合抽取时间、高度、宽度位置编码练习。
papers.summary_en: Use dynamic resolution and multimodal RoPE, with temporal, height, and width positions as exercise components.
papers.scope: 连续频率分段的三轴旋转位置编码；使用等宽三轴的教学配置，不包含动态分辨率编码器。
papers.scope_en: Contiguous frequency chunks for three-axis rotary positions in an equal-axis teaching configuration; exclude the dynamic-resolution encoder.

papers.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
papers.summary: 原生动态分辨率视觉编码、窗口注意力与视频绝对时间定位。
papers.summary_en: Combine native dynamic-resolution visual encoding, window attention, and absolute temporal localization in video.
papers.scope: 动态分辨率下的窗口分组、空间合并顺序与累计长度；不实现完整 ViT 或 GPU 内核。
papers.scope_en: Window grouping, spatial-merge ordering, and cumulative lengths for dynamic resolutions; exclude the complete ViT and GPU kernels.

papers.title: InternVL3: Exploring Advanced Training and Test-Time Recipes for Open-Source Multimodal Models
papers.summary: 原生多模态预训练、可变视觉位置编码与偏好优化。
papers.summary_en: Study native multimodal pretraining, variable visual positional encoding, and preference optimization.
papers.scope: 每图像可变增量的位置递推、跨模态累计与梯度；原点明确固定为 -1，不实现完整旋转嵌入或 InternVL 训练。
papers.scope_en: Per-image position increments, cumulative multimodal offsets, and gradients with an explicit origin of -1; exclude full rotary embeddings and InternVL training.

papers.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
papers.summary: 交错 MRoPE、多层视觉特征注入和文本时间戳对齐。
papers.summary_en: Combine interleaved MRoPE, multilevel visual feature injection, and text-based timestamp alignment.
papers.scope: 交错频率轴分配与半维配对旋转；使用等宽三轴的教学配置，不包含 DeepStack 或完整视频模型。
papers.scope_en: Interleaved frequency-axis allocation and half-split rotary pairs in an equal-axis teaching configuration; exclude DeepStack and the full video model.

papers.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
papers.summary: Thinker–Talker 架构、音视频时间对齐和流式语音输出。
papers.summary_en: Use a Thinker–Talker architecture for temporally aligned audio-video understanding and streaming speech output.
papers.scope: 两秒块内视频优先的流交错和 40ms 时间格映射；不包含音视频编码器、Thinker–Talker 或语音波形生成。
papers.scope_en: Video-first stream interleaving within two-second chunks and a shared 40 ms temporal grid; exclude audiovisual encoders, Thinker–Talker, and waveform generation.

papers.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
papers.authors: Stephane Ross, Geoffrey Gordon, Drew Bagnell
papers.summary: 在当前策略访问的状态上收集专家动作并聚合数据，处理分布偏移。
papers.summary_en: Aggregate expert actions at states visited by the current policy to address distribution shift.
papers.scope: 提取 DAgger Algorithm 3.1 的数据闭环；标量线性环境中重新拟合策略，不实现完整交互式专家或分类器。
papers.scope_en: Isolate Algorithm 3.1 in a scalar linear environment with policy refitting; no interactive human expert or full classifier.

papers.title: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
papers.summary: Transformer 与条件 VAE 预测动作块；可练动作块重叠执行和时间集成。
papers.summary_en: Predict action chunks with a Transformer and conditional VAE, with overlapping execution and temporal ensembling as exercise components.
papers.scope: 实现ACT的两个张量核心；输入已经对齐到同一执行时刻，省略视觉Transformer、动作块网络和遥操作系统。
papers.scope_en: Implement two ACT tensor cores with predictions already aligned to one execution time; omit the visual Transformer, action-chunk network and teleoperation system.

papers.title: RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.summary: 统一具有物理意义的动作空间，用扩散 Transformer 学习双臂动作。
papers.summary_en: Unify physically meaningful action spaces and use a diffusion Transformer to learn bimanual actions.
papers.scope: 提取RDT统一动作空间与采样输出mask；使用可配置小槽表，不复制完整128维schema或12亿参数Transformer。
papers.scope_en: Isolate unified action placement and final sampling masks using a configurable small slot map, not the complete 128D schema or 1.2B Transformer.

papers.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
papers.summary: 语言条件视觉 token 输入与离散动作预测。
papers.summary_en: Predict discrete actions from language-conditioned visual tokens.
papers.scope: 提取视觉token压缩器；MLP注意力logits作为输入，不训练EfficientNet、Transformer或真实机器人。
papers.scope_en: Isolate visual-token compression with supplied MLP attention logits; omit EfficientNet, the Transformer and physical robots.

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.summary: 把动作表示为文本 token，联合视觉语言任务与机器人轨迹训练。
papers.summary_en: Represent actions as text tokens and jointly train on vision-language tasks and robot trajectories.
papers.scope: 实现机器人任务与视觉语言任务共享logits时的输出约束；动作token集合由调用者提供，不运行PaLI-X、PaLM-E或语义推理。
papers.scope_en: Implement output constraints for robot and vision-language rows sharing logits; callers supply action-token identities. Omit PaLI-X, PaLM-E and semantic reasoning.

papers.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
papers.summary: Transformer 加扩散动作解码器，支持不同观测与动作空间的适配。
papers.summary_en: Combine a Transformer with a diffusion action decoder to adapt across observation and action spaces.
papers.scope: 提取官方动作头的masked_mean及时间/动作padding交集；计算未乘额外action_dim系数的逐坐标平方误差，不实现扩散网络。
papers.scope_en: Isolate the action head masked_mean and intersection of timestep/action padding. Compute coordinatewise squared error before any head-specific action_dim scaling; omit the diffusion network.

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.summary: 视觉语言表征到动作 token，适合练习动作离散化和反归一化。
papers.summary_en: Map vision-language representations to action tokens, with action discretization and unnormalization as exercise components.
papers.scope: 复现官方ActionTokenizer的离散约定及动作反归一化；不加载7B模型。边界数组可缩小以便手算，默认论文规模为256个边界、255个中心。
papers.scope_en: Reproduce official ActionTokenizer conventions and action unnormalization without a 7B model. Smaller edge arrays make examples inspectable; the official default has 256 edges and 255 centers.

papers.title: π₀: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
papers.summary: 在 VLM 上增加通过 flow matching 生成连续动作块的动作专家。
papers.summary_en: Add a flow-matching action expert to a vision-language model to generate continuous action chunks.
papers.scope: 提取官方openpi的线性流路径和Euler采样方向；显式给定噪声与时间，用线性速度回归替代VLA动作专家。
papers.scope_en: Isolate the official openpi linear flow path and Euler sampling direction; explicit noise/time and a linear velocity regressor replace the VLA action expert.

papers.title: π₀.₅: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
papers.summary: 联合高层语义任务与低层动作学习，扩展开放环境泛化。
papers.summary_en: Jointly learn high-level semantic tasks and low-level actions to improve generalization in open environments.
papers.scope: 实现论文附录E/Figure18的训练注意力连接；prefix、离散FAST标签和连续动作expert的内容由调用者给定，省略模型预训练。
papers.scope_en: Implement Appendix E / Figure 18 training attention connectivity. Prefix, discrete FAST labels and continuous action-expert contents are supplied; omit model pretraining.

papers.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
papers.authors: Danijar Hafner, Jurgis Pasukonis, Jimmy Ba, Timothy Lillicrap
papers.summary: 在潜在世界模型的想象轨迹上学习策略，使用跨任务稳定化机制。
papers.summary_en: Learn policies from imagined trajectories in a latent world model using stabilization mechanisms that transfer across tasks.
papers.scope: 实现跨数量级标量变换与离散支持编码；不训练RSSM、想象策略或Minecraft。two_hot输入已经位于symlog空间，中心由调用者指定。
papers.scope_en: Implement scale-robust scalar transforms and discrete-support encoding; omit the RSSM, imagined policy and Minecraft. two_hot receives values already in symlog space and caller-supplied centers.

papers.title: DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning
papers.authors: Philipp Wu, Alejandro Escontrela, Danijar Hafner, Ken Goldberg, Pieter Abbeel
papers.summary: 将世界模型学习和想象策略训练用于真实机器人在线交互。
papers.summary_en: Apply world-model learning and imagined policy training to online interaction with physical robots.
papers.scope: 提取DayDreamer继承DreamerV2的KL balancing核心，固定alpha默认0.8；计算free-nats截断之前的KL，不实现RSSM或机器人在线训练。
papers.scope_en: Isolate the DreamerV2-style KL balancing used by DayDreamer, with default alpha=0.8. Compute KL before free-nats clipping; omit the RSSM and online robot training.

papers.title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
papers.authors: Nicklas Hansen, Hao Su, Xiaolong Wang
papers.summary: 在潜在世界模型内进行局部轨迹优化，结合模型预测和价值估计。
papers.summary_en: Optimize local trajectories inside a latent world model by combining model predictions with value estimates.
papers.scope: 提取SimNorm与MPPI已选精英的加权矩更新；候选轨迹与价值作为输入，不学习动力学/Q网络或执行真实MPC。
papers.scope_en: Isolate SimNorm and MPPI weighted moments for already-selected elites. Candidate trajectories and values are supplied; omit learned dynamics/Q networks and real MPC.

papers.title: DeepMimic: Example-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning of Physics-Based Character Skills
papers.authors: Xue Bin Peng, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine, Michiel van de Panne
papers.summary: 结合动作模仿与任务奖励学习物理角色控制。
papers.summary_en: Learn physics-based character control by combining motion imitation with task rewards.
papers.scope: 实现姿态、角速度、末端与质心四项模仿奖励；姿态输入为预先计算的四元数测地角误差，不实现PPO、姿态解析或物理仿真。
papers.scope_en: Implement pose, angular-velocity, end-effector and center-of-mass imitation rewards. Pose inputs are precomputed quaternion geodesic angle errors; omit PPO, pose parsing and physical simulation.

papers.title: DiffMimic: Efficient Motion Mimicking with Differentiable Physics
papers.authors: Jiawei Ren, Cunjun Yu, Siwei Chen, Xiao Ma, Liang Pan, Ziwei Liu
papers.summary: 通过可微物理对状态匹配损失反传，并用示范回放稳定长时域优化。
papers.summary_en: Backpropagate state-matching losses through differentiable physics and stabilize long-horizon optimization with demonstration replay.
papers.scope: 实现论文状态误差触发的示范回放、PD力矩和时域状态匹配；实验是标量可微积分器，不是Brax人形机器人复现。
papers.scope_en: Implement error-triggered demonstration replay, PD torque and temporal state matching. The experiment uses a scalar differentiable integrator, not a Brax humanoid reproduction.

papers.title: GPipe: Efficient Training of Giant Neural Networks using Pipeline Parallelism
papers.summary: 按层分配设备，拆分 microbatch，以流水线和梯度累积训练大模型。
papers.summary_en: Partition layers across devices and split batches into microbatches for pipelined execution with gradient accumulation.
papers.scope: 等时分段、同步更新的 CPU 调度模型与线性回归；不模拟通信、BatchNorm或重计算。
papers.scope_en: A CPU model of equal-duration stages and synchronous updates, with linear regression; communication, BatchNorm and rematerialization are outside this kernel.

papers.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
papers.summary: 将注意力和 MLP 的矩阵运算分布到多个设备；可练列／行并行线性层。
papers.summary_en: Distribute attention and MLP matrix operations across devices, with column- and row-parallel linear layers as exercise components.
papers.scope: 单进程模拟两层 tensor-parallel MLP，包括偏置与反向梯度；采用 tanh GeLU 近似，不实现分布式通信。
papers.scope_en: A single-process tensor-parallel two-layer MLP including biases and gradients, with tanh-approximate GeLU and no distributed communication.

papers.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
papers.summary: 分片优化器状态、梯度和参数，逐步消除数据并行副本的冗余。
papers.summary_en: Shard optimizer states, gradients, and parameters to progressively remove redundancy across data-parallel replicas.
papers.scope: 等长参数分片的单进程 ZeRO-2 语义与 mixed-precision Adam 状态字节模型；不包含激活和通信缓冲区。
papers.scope_en: Single-process ZeRO-2 semantics with equal-sized shards and a mixed-precision Adam-state byte model; activations and communication buffers are excluded.

papers.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
papers.summary: 优化线程块和 warp 工作划分，减少非矩阵乘运算与通信。
papers.summary_en: Improve thread-block and warp work partitioning while reducing non-matmul operations and communication.
papers.scope: 单头方形注意力的 CPU 规格实现，含因果 mask、尾块、数值稳定性与自动微分；不计 GPU warp 时间。
papers.scope_en: A CPU specification of single-head square attention, including causal masks, tail blocks, numerical stability and autograd; no GPU warp timing.

papers.title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
papers.summary: 按生成迭代调度，让请求动态加入和离开批次。
papers.summary_en: Schedule at generation-iteration granularity so requests can dynamically join and leave batches.
papers.scope: 已完成prefill的离散生成迭代模拟，固定每轮一时间单位、每个活跃请求生成一token；不模拟selective batching算子。
papers.scope_en: Discrete generation replay after prefill, with unit-duration iterations and one token per active request; selective-batching operators are outside this kernel.

papers.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
papers.summary: RadixAttention 复用前缀 KV 缓存，并优化结构化解码。
papers.summary_en: Use RadixAttention to reuse prefix KV caches and optimize structured decoding.
papers.scope: 将 radix tree 展开为每token一个节点的语义模型；模拟前缀共享、LRU和活动请求pin，不存储真实KV tensor。
papers.scope_en: A token-node expansion of radix-tree semantics modeling shared prefixes, LRU and active-request pins, without storing actual KV tensors.

papers.title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
papers.summary: 将 prefill 分块并与 decode 混合调度，降低长 prompt 对逐 token 延迟的干扰。
papers.summary_en: Mix chunked prefill with decode scheduling to reduce the impact of long prompts on per-token latency.
papers.scope: 一次混合批次的预算分配和多轮回放；以固定token预算与最大块长替代论文的性能模型。
papers.scope_en: One hybrid-batch budget allocation and repeated replay; fixed token budgets and maximum chunks replace the paper performance model.

papers.title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
papers.summary: 分离 prefill/decode 的资源与并行配置，在延迟约束下优化有效吞吐。
papers.summary_en: Separate prefill and decode resources and parallelism settings to optimize goodput under latency constraints.
papers.scope: 一个prefill worker与一个decode worker的FCFS离散事件模型，包含KV传输等待；decode按请求串行，非实际批处理优化器。
papers.scope_en: An FCFS discrete-event model with one prefill worker and one decode worker, including KV-transfer waits; request-serial decoding is a teaching simplification.

papers.title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
papers.summary: 利用近似二阶信息与误差补偿完成低比特训练后量化。
papers.summary_en: Use approximate second-order information and error compensation for low-bit post-training quantization.
papers.scope: 给定上三角Cholesky因子的单块GPTQ核心；量化网格固定，Hessian估计、阻尼与分解由题外提供。
papers.scope_en: The single-block GPTQ core with a supplied upper Cholesky factor and fixed quantization grid; Hessian estimation, damping and factorization are supplied externally.

papers.title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.summary: 逐通道等价缩放，把激活离群值的量化难度迁移到权重。
papers.summary_en: Apply equivalent per-channel scaling to shift the quantization difficulty of activation outliers into weights.
papers.scope: 校准最大值、离线scale与可微等价变换；实验用对称INT8模拟量化，未实现整数GEMM或LayerNorm融合。
papers.scope_en: Calibration maxima, offline scales and differentiable equivalent transforms; the experiment simulates symmetric INT8 without integer GEMM or LayerNorm fusion.

papers.title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
papers.summary: 根据激活统计选择重要通道，通过等价缩放保护低比特权重量化精度。
papers.summary_en: Use activation statistics to identify important channels and equivalent scaling to protect low-bit weight quantization accuracy.
papers.scope: 单线性层AWQ网格搜索与分组非对称量化，使用平均绝对激活统计；不包含权重clipping搜索或TinyChat内核。
papers.scope_en: Single-linear-layer AWQ grid search and asymmetric group quantization using mean absolute activation statistics; clipping search and TinyChat kernels are excluded.

papers.title: ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.summary: 从人类偏好学习奖励模型，再用 ReFL 将奖励反馈给生成器。
papers.summary_en: Learn a reward model from human preferences, then use ReFL to feed reward signals back to the generator.
papers.scope: 训练小型奖励评分器并通过冻结奖励函数更新单步噪声预测；不加载 BLIP 或图像解码器。
papers.scope_en: Train a small reward scorer and update an epsilon predictor through a fixed differentiable reward; no BLIP or image decoder.

papers.title: Aligning Diffusion Models by Optimizing Human Utility
papers.summary: 从单张图像的喜欢／不喜欢反馈优化效用，不要求成对偏好。
papers.summary_en: Optimize utility from likes and dislikes on individual images without requiring paired preferences.
papers.scope: 输入已计算的每步 log-prob；实现 KTO 效用与停止梯度约定，不训练图像骨干。
papers.scope_en: Work with precomputed per-transition log probabilities; implement KTO utility and stop-gradient semantics without an image backbone.

papers.title: Using Human Feedback to Fine-tune Diffusion Models without Any Reward Model
papers.summary: 用直接偏好优化更新去噪策略，省去显式奖励模型。
papers.summary_en: Apply direct preference optimization to the denoising policy without training an explicit reward model.
papers.scope: 实现给定轨迹 log-prob 的逐步 D3PO 损失；不把多步概率先相乘。

module.goal_en: Coarsen the vocabulary into student top-k entries and one tail bin while preserving total probability mass.
module.scope: 实现 top-k 选择、尾部 logsumexp 和 reverse KL；测试与信息损失曲线已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement top-k selection, complementary logsumexp, and reverse KL; tests and information curves are supplied.

problems.title: REPA 表征对齐损失

module.goal: 将扩散模型的噪声特征逐 patch 对齐到冻结的干净图像教师表征。
module.goal_en: Align noisy diffusion features patch by patch to frozen clean-image representations.
module.scope: 实现对齐损失和总目标；提供已投影特征，不训练完整 DiT 或教师编码器。
module.scope_en: Implement alignment and the combined objective on projected features; full DiT and teacher training are outside this module.

problems.title: Rotation Trick 向量量化梯度

module.goal: 在量化前向保持码本值，同时通过冻结的旋转与缩放传递梯度。
module.goal_en: Keep the quantized forward value while transporting encoder gradients through a frozen scaled rotation.
module.scope: 输入已选好的码本向量，仅实现梯度替代器；不实现码本学习或完整 VQ-VAE。
module.scope_en: Given the selected code, implement the gradient surrogate; codebook learning and a full VQ-VAE are outside this module.

problems.title: Differential Transformer 差分注意力

module.goal: 用两张注意力图的差分抵消共有响应，并正确传播可学习 lambda 的梯度。
module.goal_en: Subtract two attention maps to cancel shared responses and propagate gradients through a learned lambda.
module.scope: 实现已投影 Q/K/V 的差分注意力与 lambda；每头归一化、输出投影和整个语言模型不在本题范围。
module.scope_en: Implement projected differential attention and lambda; per-head normalization, output projection and the full language model are outside this module.

problems.title: Block Diffusion 分块注意力

module.goal: 用一次注意力前向同时处理各噪声块与干净上下文，阻止目标泄漏。
module.goal_en: Process noisy blocks and clean context in one attention pass without leaking clean targets.
module.scope: 实现训练期的专用掩码及稠密注意力；不实现离散扩散采样、NELBO 或 KV cache。
module.scope_en: Implement the specialized training mask and dense attention; discrete diffusion sampling, NELBO and KV caching are outside this module.

problems.title: DistiLLM-2 双源非对称蒸馏

module.goal: 实现教师回答的 SKL、学生回答的 SRKL 和 Eq.2 配对损失。
module.goal_en: Implement teacher-response SKL, student-response SRKL and the paired Eq.2 loss.
module.scope: 固定系数、全词表条件分布；响应已提供，保留 1/(2B) 归约。
module.scope_en: Fixed coefficients and full conditional vocabularies; responses are supplied, retaining the 1/(2B) reduction.

problems.title: PKPO 奖励变换与无偏策略梯度

module.goal: 实现期望最大值及 sloo-minus-one 无偏策略梯度。
module.goal_en: Implement expected maximum and the sloo-minus-one policy gradient.
module.scope: 已采样动作与 log-prob；包含连续奖励及 k=1 约定，不训练语言模型。
module.scope_en: Supplied actions and log probabilities; continuous rewards and an explicit k=1 convention, without LLM training.

en.title: PKPO Reward Transform and Unbiased Policy Gradient

problems.title: SVDQuant 平滑、低秩与残差量化

module.goal: 实现平滑、截断 SVD 和低精度残差双分支前向。
module.goal_en: Implement smoothing, truncated SVD and a quantized residual two-branch forward.
module.scope: 给定平滑系数及 INT fake quantizer；单次 SVD，无校准搜索、FP4、迭代细化或 GPU 内核。
module.scope_en: Given smoothing factors and an INT fake quantizer; one SVD, no calibration search, FP4, iterative refinement or GPU kernels.

en.title: SVDQuant Smoothing, Low-rank and Residual Quantization

problems.title: MoGe 鲁棒最优对齐

module.goal: 通过加权 L1 折点与深度锚点，精确求解相机坐标点图的尺度及 z 平移。
module.goal_en: Solve shared scale and z translation exactly using weighted L1 breakpoints and depth anchors.
module.scope: 实现 ROE 的全局对齐核心；CPU 小点集枚举，不包含点图网络、多尺度球域或相机恢复。
module.scope_en: Implement the global ROE alignment core on tiny point sets; exclude the point-map network, multi-scale spheres and camera recovery.

problems.title: DAPS 解耦后验采样

module.goal: 用观测条件 score 做 Langevin 更新，再从干净样本独立加噪进入下一噪声层。
module.goal_en: Use a measurement-conditioned score for Langevin updates, then independently re-noise the clean sample.
module.scope: 实现线性观测下的 DAPS Eq.(7) 内核和重加噪。ODE 输出、噪声、循环由脚手架提供；不训练扩散网络。
module.scope_en: Implement DAPS Eq. (7) for a linear observation and the re-noising kernel. ODE estimates, noises and the loop are supplied; no diffusion network training.

problems.title: DiffusionNFT 正负双分支流匹配

module.goal: 从单个可训练 velocity 构造隐式正负策略，并通过概率奖励联合优化。
module.goal_en: Construct implicit positive and negative policies from one trainable velocity and optimize both with probabilistic rewards.
module.scope: 实现 Eq.(5) 训练核心；提供前向加噪与微型训练脚手架，不包含图像奖励模型、在线采样或 EMA 更新。
module.scope_en: Implement the Eq. (5) training core; forward noising and tiny training scaffolding are supplied. Image reward models, online rollouts and EMA updates are excluded.

en.title: DiffusionNFT Positive and Negative Flow Matching

problems.title: VAR 下一尺度预测

module.goal: 构造只依赖更低尺度 token 的输入，以及尺度内双向、尺度间因果的可见性矩阵。
module.goal_en: Build lower-scale teacher inputs and a scale-causal visibility matrix.
module.scope: 冻结 tokenizer，插值与投影 helper 已提供；仅实现输入构造和 mask，不训练完整 Transformer。
module.scope_en: Frozen tokenizer helpers are provided; implement teacher inputs and masking, without a full Transformer.

problems.title: VAR 多尺度残差量化

module.goal: 从粗到细量化剩余特征，并在最大分辨率累计重建。
module.goal_en: Quantize residual features from coarse to fine and accumulate full-resolution reconstructions.
module.scope: 给定编码特征、共享码本与尺度投影，仅实现冻结 tokenizer 的编码和解码；不训练 VQ-VAE。
module.scope_en: Given features, a shared codebook and scale projections, implement frozen tokenizer encoding and decoding; VQ-VAE training is outside scope.

problems.title: FD-loss 总体矩与 EMA

module.goal: 通过原始一阶、二阶矩保留总体信息，只让当前微批次接收梯度。
module.goal_en: Track population information through raw first and second moments while differentiating only the current microbatch.
module.scope: 实现论文默认 EMA 统计估计器；提供确定性特征流。FIFO 队列、多 GPU、图像特征提取与生成器不在本题范围内。
module.scope_en: Implement the default EMA statistics estimator with a supplied deterministic feature stream. FIFO queues, multiple GPUs, image feature extraction and a generator are outside this module.

problems.title: FD-loss 可微 Fréchet 损失

module.goal: 对总体高斯统计计算可微 Fréchet 距离，并实现停止分母梯度的表征损失归一化。
module.goal_en: Differentiate Gaussian population Fréchet distance and normalize representation losses with a stopped denominator.
module.scope: 实现 Eq.(2)、Eq.(6) 与附录 B.3 的对称矩阵迹算法；提供 EMA、二维生成器和优化循环，不训练图像表征网络。
module.scope_en: Implement Eq. (2), Eq. (6), and the symmetric trace algorithm from Appendix B.3. EMA, the 2D generator and the optimizer loop are provided; no image representation model is trained.

problems.title: VICReg 方差、不变性与协方差

module.goal: 实现显式防塌缩与去冗余目标，区分方差下界和协方差惩罚。
module.goal_en: Implement an explicit anti-collapse and redundancy objective, separating a variance floor from covariance penalties.
module.scope: 只实现两视图特征上的三个标量项与加权目标；编码器、投影头与分布式特征收集由题目范围排除。
module.scope_en: Implement three scalar terms and their weighted sum on two feature views. Encoder, projector and distributed gathering are outside the module.

problems.title: LeJEPA 切片高斯正则 SIGReg

module.goal: 通过一维切片的经验特征函数约束标准高斯分布，并保留特征梯度。
module.goal_en: Match a standard Gaussian through sliced empirical characteristic functions while retaining feature gradients.
module.scope: 给定单位投影方向与正半轴积分网格，实现 Epps-Pulley 统计量与切片平均；无需抽样方向、编码器、多视图预测或分布式通信。
module.scope_en: Given unit projection directions and a positive quadrature grid, implement Epps-Pulley statistics and their slice mean. Direction sampling, encoders, multiview prediction and distributed communication are supplied or outside scope.

problems.title: VISReg 尺度与分布形状正则

module.goal: 分离特征尺度、分布形状和视图一致性，并实现准确的梯度边界。
module.goal_en: Separate feature scale, distribution shape and view invariance with the correct gradient boundaries.
module.scope: 实现论文正则项和全局视图均值一致性；给定投影方向和特征，不实现编码器或图像预训练。
module.scope_en: Implement the paper regularizer and global-view-mean invariance with supplied directions and features; encoders and image pretraining are outside this module.

problems.title: I-JEPA 掩码潜在目标与 EMA

module.goal: 提取冻结的目标块，训练潜在预测并维护动量目标参数。
module.goal_en: Extract frozen target blocks, train latent predictions and maintain momentum target parameters.
module.scope: 实现官方代码中的目标层归一化、掩码收集、smooth L1 和 EMA；给定目标特征与掩码，不实现 ViT 或掩码采样。
module.scope_en: Implement target layer normalization, masked extraction, smooth L1 and EMA from the author code; target features and masks are supplied, without a ViT or mask sampler.

en.title: I-JEPA Masked Latent Targets and EMA

problems.title: LeWM 联合预测与潜在展开

module.goal: 实现保留双向编码器梯度的下一状态预测目标，以及动作条件潜在状态递推。
module.goal_en: Implement next-state teacher forcing with both encoder paths differentiable, then recursively roll out action-conditioned latent states.
module.scope: 编码器、因果预测器与 SIGReg 由调用方提供；实现时间对齐、损失组合和单状态上下文展开。
module.scope_en: Encoder, causal predictor and SIGReg are supplied by the caller. Implement temporal alignment, objective composition and single-state-context rollout.

en.title: LeWM Joint Prediction and Latent Rollout

problems.title: LeWM 潜在空间 CEM 规划

module.goal: 用最终潜在状态给动作序列打分，并从最优候选重估 CEM 采样分布。
module.goal_en: Score action sequences by their terminal latent state and refit the CEM sampling distribution from elites.
module.scope: 实现终态代价与对角高斯精英统计；采样循环、冻结动力学模型及动作边界已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement terminal scoring and diagonal-Gaussian elite statistics; the sampling loop, frozen transition model and action bounds are supplied.

problems.title: Causal-JEPA 对象轨迹遮蔽

module.goal: 沿时间遮蔽对象轨迹、保留首帧身份锚点，并实现冻结目标的历史与未来联合预测损失。
module.goal_en: Mask object trajectories across time, preserve first-frame identity anchors, and implement masked-history plus future prediction against frozen targets.
module.scope: 提供对象 slot、投影矩阵与时间嵌入；实现输入组装和损失，不训练视觉编码器或完整 Transformer。
module.scope_en: Object slots, projection weights and time embeddings are supplied; implement input assembly and losses without training an image encoder or full transformer.

problems.title: RMSNorm 与部分特征归一化

module.goal: 实现不去均值的 RMSNorm，以及用前 k 个特征估计尺度的 pRMSNorm。
module.goal_en: Implement RMSNorm without mean centering and pRMSNorm with a first-k-feature scale estimate.
module.scope: 补全两个归一化函数；显式给出 k，epsilon 放在平方根内；提供统计偏差与平移实验。
module.scope_en: Complete two normalization functions with explicit k and epsilon inside the square root; prefix-bias and offset experiments are supplied.

problems.title: GQA 分组注意力与 KV 头转换

module.goal: 实现组内 KV 投影均值池化与共享 KV 头的注意力，验证组映射和共享梯度。
module.goal_en: Implement group-wise KV projection mean pooling and attention with shared KV heads; verify routing and accumulated gradients.
module.scope: 补全两个核心函数；提供 MHA、GQA、MQA 的缓存容量与合成转换误差实验，不下载权重或复现上训练。
module.scope_en: Complete two core functions; supplied experiments compare MHA/GQA/MQA cache capacity and synthetic conversion error without checkpoint downloads or uptraining.

problems.title: RoPE 旋转位置编码

module.goal: 实现相邻特征对的旋转位置编码，理解相对位置内积和缓存偏移。
module.goal_en: Rotate adjacent feature pairs and understand relative-position logits and cached-decoding offsets.
module.scope: 只实现 apply_rope；提供相对位置与分块 KV 缓存实验，不训练 RoFormer 或扩展上下文。
module.scope_en: Implement apply_rope; supplied experiments cover relative positions and chunked KV caching without RoFormer training or context-extension methods.

problems.title: TIGER：残差量化与语义 ID

module.goal: 逐层量化剩余误差，并为共享语义元组的物品分配唯一后缀。
module.goal_en: Quantize the remaining residual at each level and assign unique suffixes to colliding items.
module.scope: 实现冻结码本的残差编码与组内碰撞后缀；不训练编码器、解码器或码本。
module.scope_en: Frozen residual encoding from Section 3.1 and collision suffixes from Section 4; no encoder/decoder/codebook training.

en.title: TIGER: Residual Quantization and Semantic IDs

problems.title: TIGER：生成 ID 与合法物品召回

module.goal: 累计条件 log 概率生成完整 ID，再过滤无效和重复物品。
module.goal_en: Generate complete IDs with cumulative conditional log-probabilities, then filter invalid and duplicate items.
module.scope: 实现无约束完整 ID 的 beam 解码，再查表过滤合法物品；不训练序列模型或使用前缀匹配。
module.scope_en: Sections 3.2 and 4.5: unconstrained full-ID beam decoding followed by exact catalog filtering; fixed logits, no seq2seq training or prefix matching.

en.title: TIGER: Generate IDs and Retrieve Valid Items

problems.title: ColBERT：逐 token MaxSim 与成对排序

module.goal: 保留逐 token 匹配证据，并用稳定的成对损失优化正负文档排序。
module.goal_en: Preserve per-token matching evidence and optimize positive/negative document ranking with a stable pairwise loss.
module.scope: 供给投影后的 token 向量，实现余弦 MaxSim 与成对 softmax 损失；不训练 BERT、分词器或 ANN 索引。
module.scope_en: Supplied projected token vectors, cosine MaxSim and pairwise softmax; no BERT encoder, tokenizer or ANN index training.

en.title: ColBERT: Token-Level MaxSim and Pairwise Ranking

problems.title: SASRec：因果历史与逐位置负采样目标

module.goal: 从历史预测下一物品，隔离未来信息并正确忽略 padding 的训练目标。
module.goal_en: Predict the next item from history while isolating future information and excluding padded training targets.
module.scope: 实现因果与 query/key padding mask，以及稳定的逐位置正负样本二元损失；编码器和小型训练循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Implement causal/query/key padding visibility and stable position-wise binary loss; encoder and tiny training loop are provided.

en.title: SASRec: Causal Histories and Sampled Next-Item Loss

problems.title: BPR：隐式反馈与个性化成对排序

module.goal: 从完整用户历史选择未观察物品，并用可微的成对偏好训练两张因子表。
module.goal_en: Select unobserved items from complete user histories and train both factor tables with differentiable pairwise preferences.
module.scope: 用户级候选 mask、稳定的 BPR-MF 负对数似然与全表 L2 先验；三元组构造与小型训练循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Per-user candidate masks, stable BPR-MF negative log likelihood and full-table L2 prior; triple construction and tiny training loop are provided.

en.title: BPR: Implicit Feedback and Personalized Pairwise Ranking

problems.title: LightGCN：归一化二部图与多层协同传播

module.goal: 用用户—物品图传播协同信号，并保留包含初始层的可微聚合。
module.goal_en: Propagate collaborative signals through a user-item graph and differentiate the aggregation including the initial layer.
module.scope: 稠密二部图的对称归一化、线性多跳传播与均匀层平均；BPR 目标和小型训练循环已提供。
module.scope_en: Symmetric normalization of a dense bipartite graph, linear multi-hop propagation and uniform layer averaging; BPR loss and tiny training loop are provided.

en.title: LightGCN: Normalized Bipartite Graphs and Collaborative Propagation

problems.title: SimCLR 归一化温度对比损失

module.goal: 实现包含同视图负样本的 2B 锚点 NT-Xent，并验证两组输入的梯度。
module.goal_en: Implement NT-Xent over 2B anchors including same-view negatives, preserving gradients into both input views.
module.scope: 只实现 NT-Xent；已提供 6 对向量的 CPU 训练实验，不训练图像编码器或复现论文基准。
module.scope_en: Implement only NT-Xent; a supplied CPU lab trains 6 vector pairs, without an image encoder or paper benchmark reproduction.

problems.title: MoCo 动量编码器与负样本队列

module.goal: 结合只更新 query 的对比损失、动量 key 编码器与跨 batch 环形字典。
module.goal_en: Combine query-only contrastive gradients, a momentum key encoder and a cross-batch circular dictionary.
module.scope: 三个核心函数；提供 12 次实际 SGD 的合成线性编码器实验，不复现图像编码器、分布式 BN 或论文基准。
module.scope_en: Three core functions and a supplied 12-step synthetic linear-encoder SGD lab; no image encoder, distributed BN or paper benchmark reproduction.

en.title: MoCo Momentum Encoder and Negative Dictionary

problems.title: Next-token Loss：下一词预测的错位对齐

module.goal: 对齐自回归预测与下一位置标签，计算稳定平均损失。
module.goal_en: Align predictions with the next token and compute a stable average loss.
module.scope: 只实现一个核心函数；提供独立测试和确定性合成实验。
module.scope_en: Implement one core function; independent tests and deterministic synthetic experiments are provided.

problems.title: SFT Loss Mask：只学习回答 token

module.goal: 同时处理标签错位、回答掩码、padding 与有效 token 平均。
module.goal_en: Shift targets, mask prompt and padding tokens, and average loss over valid response tokens.
module.scope: 只实现一个核心函数；提供独立测试和确定性合成实验。
module.scope_en: Implement one core function; independent tests and deterministic synthetic experiments are provided.

en.title: SFT Loss Mask: Train on Response Tokens

problems.title: Top-k：温度缩放与候选概率

module.goal: 将温度缩放与精确 Top-k 候选过滤组成确定性概率变换。
module.goal_en: Apply temperature, keep exactly k candidates, and renormalize their probabilities.
module.scope: 只实现一个核心函数；提供独立测试和确定性合成实验。
module.scope_en: Implement one core function; independent tests and deterministic synthetic experiments are provided.

problems.title: Top-p：累计概率与核采样候选

module.goal: 正确保留累计概率阈值边界，并恢复词表顺序。
module.goal_en: Keep the smallest candidate set that reaches the probability threshold, then restore vocabulary order.
module.scope: 只实现一个核心函数；提供独立测试和确定性合成实验。
module.scope_en: Implement one core function; independent tests and deterministic synthetic experiments are provided.

en.title: Top-p: Cumulative Probability and Nucleus Candidates

problems.title: 梯度累积：按有效 token 数加权

module.goal: 让不等长 microbatch 的平均梯度等价于一个有效 token 大 batch。
module.goal_en: Weight microbatch gradients by valid token counts to match one combined batch.
module.scope: 只实现一个核心函数；提供独立测试和确定性合成实验。
module.scope_en: Implement one core function; independent tests and deterministic synthetic experiments are provided.

problems.title: 全局梯度裁剪：一个范数缩放所有参数

module.goal: 计算跨参数的全局范数，并用统一比例裁剪。
module.goal_en: Compute one gradient norm across all parameters and apply a shared clipping scale.
module.scope: 只实现一个核心函数；提供独立测试和确定性合成实验。
module.scope_en: Implement one core function; independent tests and deterministic synthetic experiments are provided.

en.title: Global Gradient Clipping: One Norm for All Parameters

problems.title: GroupNorm：分组统计与批次独立性

module.goal: 实现每个样本内的分组归一化，保留逐通道仿射参数及统计量的梯度。
module.goal_en: Implement per-sample group normalization with per-channel affine parameters and differentiable statistics.
module.scope: 补全一个函数；提供独立标量检查、梯度检查和批次组成实验，无需训练模型。
module.scope_en: Complete one function; independent scalar checks, gradient checks and a batch-composition experiment are supplied, without model training.

en.title: GroupNorm: Grouped Statistics and Batch Independence

problems.title: Top-p：从候选概率到抽取 token

module.goal: 用逆累计分布从核采样概率中抽出词表 token。
module.goal_en: Draw vocabulary token IDs from nucleus probabilities using an inverse CDF.
module.scope: 提供核概率函数；实现逐行抽样、随机数流和词表索引映射。
module.scope_en: The nucleus probability helper is provided; implement per-row sampling, random-stream ownership and vocabulary indexing.

en.title: Top-p: Draw Tokens from the Nucleus

problems.title: 多轮 SFT：回答标签与会话边界

module.goal: 从结构化角色生成多轮回答标签，排除 padding 与跨会话预测。

problems.title: RDT-1B 统一动作槽与有效维度

problems.title: RT-2 动作词表约束解码

problems.title: Octo 双重padding掩码归约

module.scope_en: Isolate the action head masked_mean and intersection of timestep/action padding. Compute coordinatewise squared error before any head-specific action_dim scaling; omit the diffusion network.

problems.title: OpenVLA 动作token与分位数还原

problems.title: π0 反向时间流与动作积分

problems.title: π0.5 混合动作头防泄漏注意力

problems.title: DreamerV3 symlog与two-hot价值编码

problems.title: DayDreamer 离散世界模型KL平衡

module.scope_en: Isolate the DreamerV2-style KL balancing used by DayDreamer, with default alpha=0.8. Compute KL before free-nats clipping; omit the RSSM and online robot training.

problems.title: TD-MPC2 单纯形潜变量与精英轨迹更新

problems.title: DeepMimic 四分量动作模仿奖励

problems.title: DiffMimic 示范回放与可微PD控制

module.scope_en: Implement error-triggered demonstration replay, PD torque and temporal state matching. The experiment uses a scalar differentiable integrator, not a Brax humanoid reproduction.

en.title: DiffMimic Demonstration Replay and Differentiable PD Control

problems.title: GPipe 填充排空与微批次梯度

module.goal_en: Build fill-drain events and preserve full-batch mean gradients under microbatching.

module.scope_en: A CPU model of equal-duration stages and synchronous updates, with linear regression; communication, BatchNorm and rematerialization are outside this kernel.

en.title: GPipe Fill-Drain Scheduling and Microbatch Gradients

problems.title: Megatron 列并行与行并行 MLP

module.scope_en: A single-process tensor-parallel two-layer MLP including biases and gradients, with tanh-approximate GeLU and no distributed communication.

problems.title: ZeRO-2 分片 Adam 与状态内存

en.title: ZeRO-2 Sharded Adam and State Memory

problems.title: FlashAttention-2 延后归一化与行块
