module.scope: 单头方形注意力的 CPU 规格实现，含因果 mask、尾块、数值稳定性与自动微分；不计 GPU warp 时间。
module.scope_en: A CPU specification of single-head square attention, including causal masks, tail blocks, numerical stability and autograd; no GPU warp timing.

en.title: FlashAttention-2 Delayed Normalization and Query Blocks

problems.title: Orca 迭代级动态批处理

module.scope: 已完成prefill的离散生成迭代模拟，固定每轮一时间单位、每个活跃请求生成一token；不模拟selective batching算子。
module.scope_en: Discrete generation replay after prefill, with unit-duration iterations and one token per active request; selective-batching operators are outside this kernel.

problems.title: SGLang 前缀 KV 缓存与叶节点 LRU

module.goal: 寻找最长缓存前缀，并在容量限制下只驱逐未被占用的叶节点。
module.goal_en: Find the longest cached prefix and evict only unpinned leaves under a capacity limit.
module.scope: 将 radix tree 展开为每token一个节点的语义模型；模拟前缀共享、LRU和活动请求pin，不存储真实KV tensor。
module.scope_en: A token-node expansion of radix-tree semantics modeling shared prefixes, LRU and active-request pins, without storing actual KV tensors.

en.title: SGLang Prefix KV Cache and Leaf-Only LRU

problems.title: Sarathi-Serve Decode 优先与分块 Prefill

module.goal: 先为所有decode保留token预算，再为队首prefill分配不超过上限的块。
module.goal_en: Reserve tokens for every ongoing decode before assigning bounded chunks to FIFO prefills.
module.scope: 一次混合批次的预算分配和多轮回放；以固定token预算与最大块长替代论文的性能模型。
module.scope_en: One hybrid-batch budget allocation and repeated replay; fixed token budgets and maximum chunks replace the paper performance model.

en.title: Sarathi-Serve Decode Priority and Chunked Prefill

problems.title: DistServe 分离队列与双延迟 SLO

module.goal_en: Replay separate prefill/decode queues and compute goodput subject to both TTFT and TPOT.
module.scope: 一个prefill worker与一个decode worker的FCFS离散事件模型，包含KV传输等待；decode按请求串行，非实际批处理优化器。
module.scope_en: An FCFS discrete-event model with one prefill worker and one decode worker, including KV-transfer waits; request-serial decoding is a teaching simplification.

en.title: DistServe Disaggregated Queues and Dual Latency SLOs

problems.title: GPTQ Cholesky 误差补偿量化

module.goal: 按固定列顺序量化权重，并用逆Hessian的Cholesky因子补偿剩余列误差。
module.goal_en: Quantize columns in fixed order and compensate remaining columns using the inverse-Hessian Cholesky factor.
module.scope: 给定上三角Cholesky因子的单块GPTQ核心；量化网格固定，Hessian估计、阻尼与分解由题外提供。
module.scope_en: The single-block GPTQ core with a supplied upper Cholesky factor and fixed quantization grid; Hessian estimation, damping and factorization are supplied externally.

problems.title: SmoothQuant 激活与权重等价平滑

module.goal: 计算逐输入通道平滑因子，并验证相反方向缩放保持线性层输出与梯度。
module.goal_en: Compute input-channel smoothing factors and preserve linear-layer outputs and gradients under reciprocal scaling.
module.scope: 校准最大值、离线scale与可微等价变换；实验用对称INT8模拟量化，未实现整数GEMM或LayerNorm融合。
module.scope_en: Calibration maxima, offline scales and differentiable equivalent transforms; the experiment simulates symmetric INT8 without integer GEMM or LayerNorm fusion.

en.title: SmoothQuant Equivalent Activation and Weight Smoothing

problems.title: AWQ 激活感知缩放校准

module.goal: 实现分组反量化，并以校准输出误差选择激活感知缩放指数。

module.scope: 单线性层AWQ网格搜索与分组非对称量化，使用平均绝对激活统计；不包含权重clipping搜索或TinyChat内核。
module.scope_en: Single-linear-layer AWQ grid search and asymmetric group quantization using mean absolute activation statistics; clipping search and TinyChat kernels are excluded.

problems.title: ImageReward 排序学习与 ReFL 单步反馈

module.goal: 实现偏好排序损失，以及冻结前缀后的单步干净样本预测。
module.goal_en: Implement pairwise reward ranking and one-step clean prediction from a frozen rollout prefix.
module.scope: 训练小型奖励评分器并通过冻结奖励函数更新单步噪声预测；不加载 BLIP 或图像解码器。
module.scope_en: Train a small reward scorer and update an epsilon predictor through a fixed differentiable reward; no BLIP or image decoder.

en.title: ImageReward Ranking and ReFL One-Step Feedback

problems.title: Diffusion-KTO 二元反馈与效用基线

module.goal: 用独立样本估计非负 KL 基线，并对喜欢／不喜欢反馈优化 sigmoid 效用。
module.goal_en: Estimate a nonnegative baseline from unrelated pairs and optimize sigmoid utility for binary feedback.
module.scope: 输入已计算的每步 log-prob；实现 KTO 效用与停止梯度约定，不训练图像骨干。
module.scope_en: Work with precomputed per-transition log probabilities; implement KTO utility and stop-gradient semantics without an image backbone.

en.title: Diffusion-KTO Binary Feedback and Utility Baseline

problems.title: D3PO 逐去噪步骤偏好优化

module.goal_en: Propagate terminal preferences to denoising transitions and compute reference-corrected preference losses per step.
module.scope: 实现给定轨迹 log-prob 的逐步 D3PO 损失；不把多步概率先相乘。
module.scope_en: Implement stepwise D3PO from trajectory log probabilities, without collapsing them into one trajectory-level likelihood.

problems.title: PC-Flow 分类器的相邻时刻偏好比率

module.goal: 从相邻时刻的分类器 logits 构造参考模型无关的偏好训练目标。
module.goal_en: Build a reference-free preference objective from classifier logits at adjacent sampling times.
module.scope: 只训练偏好分类器的相邻时刻目标；基座 flow 与引导采样器不在范围内。
module.scope_en: Implement the adjacent-time classifier objective; the base flow and guided sampler are outside the exercise.

problems.title: DDPO 高斯转移密度与逐步 PPO

module.goal: 计算高斯去噪转移的联合 log 密度，并实现终点优势广播的 clipped PPO 损失。
module.goal_en: Compute joint Gaussian denoising-transition log densities and clipped PPO with terminal advantages broadcast over steps.
module.scope: 使用固定方差高斯转移实现 DDPO 的策略目标，包含在线小型 bandit；不加载扩散骨干。
module.scope_en: Implement the DDPO objective for fixed-variance Gaussian transitions and an online toy bandit, without a diffusion backbone.

en.title: DDPO Gaussian Transition Densities and Stepwise PPO

problems.title: DPOK 高斯 KL 上界与策略梯度

module.goal: 计算逐步高斯 KL，并实现奖励 score 梯度与直接 KL 梯度的组合。
module.goal_en: Compute per-step Gaussian KL and combine reward score gradients with direct KL gradients.
module.scope: 实现论文 Eq. (9) 的高效梯度近似；不声称包含 Eq. (8) 状态访问分布的完整导数。
module.scope_en: Implement the efficient gradient approximation in Eq. (9), not the full state-visitation derivative of Eq. (8).

en.title: DPOK Gaussian KL Bound and Policy Gradient

problems.title: AlignProp 去噪链的截断奖励反传

module.goal: 实现一个可控制梯度起点的 DDIM 采样链，让终点奖励穿过指定的去噪后缀反传。
module.goal_en: Implement a DDIM sampling chain whose terminal reward differentiates through a selected denoising suffix.
module.scope: 调用传入的小型 epsilon 模型，练习时间方向和梯度截断；不实现 LoRA 或 checkpoint 内存优化。
module.scope_en: Call a supplied small epsilon model to study time direction and gradient truncation; LoRA and activation checkpointing are outside scope.

problems.title: DRaFT-LV 重加噪奖励梯度平均

module.goal: 复用生成样本，通过多次重加噪和单步去噪构造低方差奖励梯度。
module.goal_en: Reuse generated samples via re-noising and one-step denoising to aggregate reward gradients.
module.scope: 实现 DRaFT-LV 额外样本的停止梯度与平均；初始生成过程由调用者提供。
module.scope_en: Implement DRaFT-LV stop-gradient and averaging for extra samples; the initial differentiable generated sample is supplied.

en.title: DRaFT-LV Reward Gradients from Re-Noised Samples

problems.title: DanceGRPO 共享初噪与组内奖励

module.goal: 构造同 prompt 共享的初始噪声、逐奖励通道组内优势，以及逐转移 GRPO 目标。
module.goal_en: Construct shared initial noise per prompt, per-reward group advantages and a transition-level GRPO objective.
module.scope: 在小型高斯生成策略中检验多奖励与共享初始条件；不运行视频骨干或视觉奖励模型。
module.scope_en: Test multiple rewards and shared initial conditions in a small Gaussian policy; no video backbone or visual reward model.

en.title: DanceGRPO Shared Initial Noise and Group Rewards

problems.title: MixGRPO 滑动随机窗口与局部策略目标

module.goal_en: Implement a training-dependent SDE window, ODE transitions outside it and a policy objective averaged only over selected steps.
module.scope: 使用论文的基础混合 ODE-SDE 形式；不包含后续 CPS 扩展或高阶求解器。
module.scope_en: Implement the basic mixed ODE-SDE formulation, excluding the later CPS extension and high-order solvers.
